summary.intent: Execute Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure) using wave-based parallel subagent execution across 3 plans: bin IPNS 404 fix, SDK load tests, and recovery page cleanup.
summary.outcome: Phase 24 execution was initiated with all 3 plans spawned in parallel. Plan 24-02 (SDK Core Load Tests + 401 Interceptor) completed successfully with 3 commits; plans 24-01 and 24-03 were still in progress when the transcript ended.

repo: Phase 24 branch is `feat/phase-24-bug-fixes-test-infrastructure` — pre-created and already checked out at execution time.

SDK core load tests use a client-pool pattern with `createSdkContext()` for headless Node.js execution rather than browser-based testing.
The 401 interceptor in client-pool uses a `reAuthenticate()` helper for automatic token refresh during load test runs.
All vaults are v2 — the export file recovery mode (v1 path) was considered dead code scheduled for removal in plan 24-03.
